events.title: 42, No Coding Background: The Story Behind Fliprium
events.summary: Can you make the card game in your head at 42? The creator of Fliprium is a 42-year-old industrial sales representative and a card-game enthusiast. With no coding background or game-industry experience, he spent a month developing Fliprium with AI assistance. The free demo is now playable on Steam. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46544072/4e9f9b037f2dca6389155b7ceadbcff69ede4443.png Actual gameplay: forging an artifact after gathering materials. events.title: Fliprium Free Demo Out Now - Explore, Craft, and Play Another Round
events.summary: Play for free and forge your first artifact The free Fliprium demo is available now! Explore the board, gather materials, and plan your artifact combinations. Look for crafting chains and high-scoring finishes in a fantasy turn-based strategy game inspired by traditional tabletop games, including mahjong. What is in the demo?
